title: Last-shot analysis
summary: Under traditional counteroffer analysis, subsequent performance can appear to accept the last communicated set of terms.
notes: The rule can favor the party whose form comes last, even though the recipient never read its boilerplate. Mid-South Plant Services illustrates factual disagreement over whose proposal performance accepted. The majority and dissent differ about whether that inference was suitable for summary judgment. Section 2-207 changes the sales analysis by separating contract formation from incorporation of unmatched terms.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 270–274. Open assigned page 270.
